_note: v1.1.0 Features settings (single source). Engine: which state each feature parks when it is off (paths) and which unlock it gates. UI: rows of Student file > Settings > Features. tools/gen_mvu_entries.py measures each feature's rule text (EJS gates on(id) in 502/504/505) and writes data/feature_cost.json. control: toggle = on/off in $ui.off; levels = its own field in $ui (level 'off' counts as off).

features.name: Planner
features.desc: Commitments: promises, appointments and deadlines with due times and overdue reminders.

features.name: Notice Board notices
features.desc: Story notices pinned on the board (paid work, recruitment, warnings). Official postings always show.

features.name: Letters
features.desc: Mail Tower letters in and out, with waiting reminders.

features.name: Mystery Board
features.desc: Clues and mystery threads you piece together.

features.name: Competition
features.desc: Your standing in the Dorm, Academy, Kingdom and World Competitions.

features.name: Projects
features.desc: Brewing, crafting, research and group work that takes more than one sitting.

features.name: Trips
features.desc: Crowning Day and the Academy Trip: who you travel with, where you are.

features.name: Battle tracking
features.desc: Opponents' health, stamina and status during a fight.

features.name: Bag (inventory)
features.desc: Things you buy, receive or find and keep; weather gear counts from here.

features.name: Campus happenings
features.desc: A small seeded happening on some days: paid work, a Dove sweep, a loose creature.

features.name: Weather
features.desc: Seasons, sky and °C per morning, afternoon and night; the Divination Society forecast. Full adds real effects: conditions, gear, sleep, bonds, who is outdoors.

features.name: Class-aware presence
features.desc: During lessons students are in class: the narrator knows your class, teacher and classmates.

features.name: Story hooks
features.desc: The narrator's private notes on promises and planted details it owes a payoff. Never shown to you.

features.name: Gossip that spreads
features.desc: Rumours reach more people day by day, then fade or die out.
